scene_summary: A luminous, intricately veined botanical scene: curled yellow-green leaves hang above and down the right edge, while lilac bell flowers and brown branching stems occupy the lower left. Dark olive depth separates the foliage and flowers. Six distinct interaction anchors are visible, although the planned silhouettes resolve as naturalistic plant forms rather than minimal expressionist marks. No reference plaque or clearly separate layered fragment is visible.

detected_objects.label: Lemon hook opening
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The hanging leaf just right of center forms a curled hook with a pale folded shoulder, dark olive inner face, and brightly rimmed lower tip. This is the closest visible match to the planned hook; it is narrower than the separate large leaf along the right edge.

detected_objects.label: Lilac branching silhouette
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The largest foreground lilac bell flower has a narrow stem attachment, translucent ribbed petals, outward-curling lateral tips, and elongated downward lobes. The contour follows this individual flower rather than enclosing the entire branching cluster.

detected_objects.label: Shadowed arch seam
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Across the upper-middle portion of the large right-hand leaf, a narrow pale doubled boundary runs diagonally down toward a bright pinched turn. The luminous lip is visibly distinct from the darker veined surface beneath it.

detected_objects.label: Brown branching glint
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A sharp white-gold star glints at the brown stem fork immediately above the large foreground flower. Short illuminated branches radiate from its center; this target stops at the junction rather than expanding into the petals.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Approximate visual coverage is modest because the supporting targets hug individual marks. The plate itself is not minimal or expressionist: dense leaf venation, numerous flower buds, branching stems, layered background foliage, and repeated refractive highlights create a highly detailed naturalistic scene. A central olive opening provides some breathing room, but small interaction anchors compete with many similar edges and glints.
